executable.title: Cell Deconvolution
executable.description: Perform cell composition deconvolution for spatial transcriptomics data using reference-based or reference-free methods.
executable.acknowledgements: This work is part of efforts in digital pathology by the Sarder Lab: UFL.

file.name: counts_file
file.label: Counts file
file.description: Counts file can either be RDS, H5AD, or "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5" output of *spaceranger* pipeline.

boolean.name: use_reference
boolean.label: Use Reference-based Cell Deconvolution
boolean.description: If selected, cell deconvolution will be performed using reference-based methods. If not selected, a reference-free method will be used.

file.name: reference_file
file.label: Reference File
file.description: Reference file can either be RDS or H5AD file containing single-cell RNA-seq data to be used for reference-based cell deconvolution.

parameters.label: Girder API URL and Key
parameters.description: A Girder API URL and token for Girder client
